sections.title: Mail BCC Support for Odoo
sections.tagline: A real Bcc in Odoo mail.
sections.subtitle: Add a Bcc to the composer, to mail templates and to outgoing emails. Other recipients never see it.

sections.flow_alt: Write a message, fill in Bcc, send, the Bcc address stays hidden
sections.html: Odoo can send a Bcc, but no screen lets you type one. This module connects the missing parts and keeps the standard sending code untouched.

items.title: In the composer
items.text: A Bcc box in the full composer and in mass mailing.

items.title: On templates
items.text: A Bcc field with placeholders, computed per record.

items.title: Truly blind
items.text: Delivered, but never written in the visible headers.

items.title: Sent once
items.text: The Bcc address gets one copy, not one per recipient.

items.title: Logged
items.text: Kept on the outgoing email and in the message log.

sections.title: Requirements & Installation
sections.intro: Needs only the standard mail module. No external library.
notes: A Bcc needs at least one other recipient (To, Cc or a partner). An email with only a Bcc is not sent.

blocks.html: 1. Copy the dwo_mail_bcc folder into an add-ons path of your Odoo server.
2. Restart Odoo, activate developer mode and click Update Apps List in the Apps menu.
3. Search for Mail BCC Support and click Install.
Open the full composer from Send message and fill in the Bcc box. It also works for mass mailing from a list.
Open an email template and fill in Bcc. Placeholders are computed for each record, and the result is added to the Bcc typed by hand without duplicates.
A Bcc address that is already a visible recipient is dropped from the Bcc, so nobody receives two copies.
The quick message box of the chatter has no Bcc box; only the full composer has one.
When several records are sent at once, the same Bcc applies to all of them.
If an outgoing email carrying a Bcc fails to send, the Bcc is delivered when that email is sent again.

items.q: Can other recipients see the Bcc?
items.a: No. The address is used for delivery only and removed from the headers.

items.q: Who can see the Bcc list in Odoo?

items.a: Yes. It is also the base of the Advanced Email Composer.
